exposure: Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs) for male infertility
Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs) for female infertility
Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs) for mixed infertility
Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs) for unexplained infertility
cohort: The study included all singleton births in Norway between 2000 and 2021 recorded in the national birth registry.
finding: The increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes in pregnancies conceived by ART was less pronounced if used for male infertility than for female infertility.
mod_finding: A higher risk of cesarean section was observed in all ART groups compared to naturally conceived pregnancies, with the risk being less pronounced for ART deliveries resulting from male infertility.
